title: kit.podcast-provenance.v1
description: The record every podcast episode row carries (podcast_episodes.provenance_json): proof it came from the pipeline. The cron writes it when it queues the episode (origin, trigger, the hashes of the spec and of the config that voiced it); the workflow adds the render facts when it publishes (provider, model, pacing, measured duration and longest pause). A row without it cannot be inserted (database trigger); the monitor fails on a published episode whose origin is not accepted.

origin.description: cron: queued by the scheduled run; cron-retry: re-queued by the scheduled run after a failed render; catchup: made by the scheduled run for a past day (inside the project's catch-up window) that had no episode, never by a person; admin: made through an admin route (not accepted by a project whose podcast.config.json sets provenance.origins); legacy: predates this record (set once, by the migration).

missed_date.description: catchup only: the day the episode was missed (the day it belongs to). Any other origin carrying it is refused (schema, JS check and the generated triggers).
